programId.description: Id of the program to query. If null, will return summary of all programs the customer is enrolled in.

programReference.description: Reference to the program to query. Better to use than programId, since programId might vary in different environments.

programReferences.description: List of reference to the programs to query. If given then it overrides the programReference parameter.

items.description: List of reference to the programs to query. If given then it overrides the programReference parameter.

statusAt.description: Get current level summary at a given date and time. Defaults to now if not set.
